title: PBX-Platform
summary: Private multi-tenant telecom core driven by a normalized 12-microservice, 76-table schema. Resilient Kamailio SIP proxy load balancers fronting Asterisk endpoints for unified extension provisioning.

title: OminiVoice
summary: In-browser WebRTC testing workbench with instant audio loopback and transcripts, no PSTN/SIP dependency. Multi-tenant lead dialling queues via Celery with usage-based Stripe billing.

title: FuelRoute Pro
summary: Greedy cost-optimization engine over live map geometry to find cheapest fuel stops per vehicle profile. Sub-30ms execution via SHA-256 coordinate-geometry caching.

title: MyCode
summary: Autonomous agentic coding CLI/TUI using local embeddings for semantic caching to cut token cost. Tree-sitter codebase indexing for surgical prompt context behind a workspace trust ledger.

title: Sasyashri
summary: Multi-tenant B2B agri-wholesale marketplace with 8 role-based portals and WebAuthn passkeys. Low-latency streaming AI voice agents via NVIDIA Riva plus OCR invoice parsing.

title: Spotter ML Platform
summary: Industrial ML workbench training a LightGBM regressor on 48K+ rows to predict logistics freight rates. Multi-step wizard pre-parses tabular structure to avoid mid-cycle memory failures.
